# gitbuddy

> Git for humans: plain-English commands over real git, a snapshot before every change (so everything can be undone), workspaces for juggling tasks without branches, and a JSON/MCP interface for AI agents.

Install: `bun install -g github:muhammad-junaid-iftikhar/git-speak-human` → command `gitbuddy`.

## For agents

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): JSON output shape, exit codes, error codes, MCP setup
- Start every task with `gitbuddy state --json`; undo any change with `gitbuddy undo <snapshot_id>`
- MCP server: `gitbuddy mcp` (stdio)
- Full command list: `gitbuddy commands --json`

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): overview and quick start
- [CHEATSHEET.md](CHEATSHEET.md): git ↔ gitbuddy mapping
- [task.md](task.md): roadmap
